info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Account Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Account Fraud Evaluation API enables businesses to assess the fraud risk associated with specific accounts based on unique parameters. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed fraud evaluation insights by providing a specific identifier. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions and risk management teams that aim to enhance security measures and protect against fraudulent activities. Use cases may involve real-time assessments during account transactions or periodic reviews of account statuses.

get.description: Fetches the detailed assessment of potential fraud for the specified resource ID, helping businesses make informed decisions based on the evaluation results.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a fraud evaluation for the specified account. It should include all necessary parameters required to identify the account and the evaluation criteria.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the fraud evaluation details.
